extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
	build_scenes()
	quit()

func build_scenes() -> void:
	# Player.tscn
	build_player()
	# Coin.tscn
	build_coin()
	# HUD.tscn
	build_hud()
	# Main.tscn
	build_main()
	print("Scenes built.")

func _save_scene(scene: Node, path: String) -> void:
	var packed_scene := PackedScene.new()
	packed_scene.pack(scene)
	ResourceSaver.save(packed_scene, path)
	print("Saved: ", path)

func build_player() -> void:
	var player := CharacterBody2D.new()
	player.name = "Player"
	player.set_script(preload("res://scenes/Player.gd"))
	var sprite := Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.name = "Sprite2D"
	# use default icon if it exists, otherwise leave empty
	if FileAccess.file_exists("res://icon.svg"):
		sprite.texture = load("res://icon.svg")
	player.add_child(sprite)
	sprite.owner = player
	var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
	shape.name = "CollisionShape2D"
	# We need a dummy shape
	shape.shape = CircleShape2D.new()
	player.add_child(shape)
	shape.owner = player
	_save_scene(player, "res://scenes/Player.tscn")
	player.free()

func build_coin() -> void:
	var coin := Area2D.new()
	coin.name = "Coin"
	coin.set_script(preload("res://scenes/Coin.gd"))
	# connect body_entered -> _on_body_entered
	coin.body_entered.connect(coin._on_body_entered)
	var sprite := Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.name = "Sprite2D"
	coin.add_child(sprite)
	sprite.owner = coin
	var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
	shape.name = "CollisionShape2D"
	shape.shape = CircleShape2D.new()
	coin.add_child(shape)
	shape.owner = coin
	_save_scene(coin, "res://scenes/Coin.tscn")
	coin.free()

func build_hud() -> void:
	var hud := CanvasLayer.new()
	hud.name = "HUD"
	hud.set_script(preload("res://scenes/HUD.gd"))
	var label := Label.new()
	label.name = "Label"
	label.text = "Coins: 0"
	hud.add_child(label)
	label.owner = hud
	_save_scene(hud, "res://scenes/HUD.tscn")
	hud.free()

func build_main() -> void:
	var main := Node2D.new()
	main.name = "Main"
	# instance Player
	var player_res := load("res://scenes/Player.tscn")
	var player := player_res.instantiate()
	main.add_child(player)
	player.owner = main
	# instance HUD
	var hud_res := load("res://scenes/HUD.tscn")
	var hud := hud_res.instantiate()
	main.add_child(hud)
	hud.owner = main
	# instance at least one coin
	var coin_res := load("res://scenes/Coin.tscn")
	for i in range(3):
		var coin := coin_res.instantiate()
		coin.name = "Coin_%d" % (i + 1)
		main.add_child(coin)
		coin.owner = main
	_save_scene(main, "res://scenes/Main.tscn")
	main.free()
